content.title: Music Video Dynamic Subtitle Generator
content.summary: Combine music, vocals, performance, camera movement, and spatial text into one rhythmic system. The Seedance companion defines audio roles, complete lyric phrases, and continuity between short segments of a longer piece.

quick_start.input_format: Music and tempo + vocal roles + complete lyric phrases + performer and setting + camera rhythm + spatial text behavior + segment handoff
quick_start.recommended_input: Combine music, vocals, performance, camera movement, and spatial text into one rhythmic system; the Seedance companion defines audio roles, closes complete lyric phrases, and preserves continuity between short segments of a longer piece.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Combine music, vocals, performance, camerawork, and spatial text into one rhythmic system; the Seedance companion defines audio roles, closes complete lyric phrases, and preserves continuity between short segments of a longer piece.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.
